title: Goddess of the Stormy Seas
description: A luminous female deity with flowing white hair and golden armor floats above a turbulent ocean, holding a glowing blue staff that emits swirling energy. Below her, two wooden sailing ships with tattered sails are tossed by massive, stormy waves as smaller figures fall into the water under a dramatic night sky filled with auroras, stars, and lightning.
prompt: A majestic goddess with long flowing white hair and ornate golden armor floats dynamically above a raging sea at night, holding a tall glowing blue magical staff that creates swirling vortexes of light and water.
